"""CPU-only audit of the two completed camera panels; photo/color review pending."""

import datetime
import json
import math
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
PLAN = json.loads((ROOT / "plan.json").read_text())
sys.path[:0] = [str(Path(PLAN["work"]) / p) for p in ("scripts", "src")]
from audit_fresh_dino_statistics import audit_real
from compare_long_commons_scores import compare_pair, descriptor, rows
from review_packed_isotropic_trial import reference_descriptor
from review_reconstruction_objective import require_completed
from train_reconstruction_objective_trial import guard, read, ref


def source_means(item, metric):
    values = defaultdict(list)
    for row in item["rows"]:
        if row["model"] == item["model_label"]:
            values[row["scene"]].append(float(row["metrics"][metric]))
    assert len(values) in (4, 5) and all(len(v) == 18 for v in values.values())
    return {k: math.fsum(v) / len(v) for k, v in values.items()}


def quantile(values, fraction):
    position = (len(values) - 1) * fraction
    lower, upper = math.floor(position), math.ceil(position)
    return values[lower] * (upper - position) + values[upper] * (position - lower)


def main():
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    guard(PLAN)
    require_completed(PLAN)
    status = read(ROOT / "status.json")
    assert {"known", "unseen"} <= set(status["completed"])
    checkpoints = read(ROOT / "training-boundary.json")["checkpoints"]
    comparisons, sources, witnesses, audit, means, errors = [], [], [], {}, {}, []
    for panel in ("known", "unseen"):
        folder = Path(PLAN["outputs"][panel])
        audit[panel] = audit_real(folder, 4 if panel == "known" else 5,
                                  8 if panel == "known" else 10,
                                  72 if panel == "known" else 90, 5,
                                  require_rawnind=False)
        report, cases = folder / "summary.json", folder / "per-crop.jsonl"
        summary, records = read(report), rows(cases)
        current = [descriptor(c["label"], c["sha256"], report, cases, summary, records)
                   for c in checkpoints]
        old = Path(PLAN["historical_panels"][panel])
        old_summary, old_records = read(old / "summary.json"), rows(old / "per-crop.jsonl")
        retained = [descriptor(c["label"], c["sha256"], old / "summary.json",
                    old / "per-crop.jsonl", old_summary, old_records)
                    for c in PLAN["historical_models"]]
        for gain in ("cfa-ls", "cfa-channel"):
            retained.append(reference_descriptor("RawNIND-" + gain, PLAN["rawnind_sha256"],
                "RawNIND:" + gain + ":publisher", old / "summary.json",
                old / "per-crop.jsonl", old_summary, old_records))
        means[panel] = {c["label"]: math.fsum(source_means(c, "sensor_psnr").values())
                        / len(source_means(c, "sensor_psnr")) for c in current + retained}
        for first, second in [(current[1], current[0])] + [(c, r) for c in current for r in retained]:
            values, source, witness = compare_pair(panel, first, second)
            comparisons.extend(values)
            sources.append(source)
            witnesses.append(witness)
            for value in values:
                a, b = source_means(first, value["metric"]), source_means(second, value["metric"])
                assert a.keys() == b.keys()
                ids = sorted(a)
                delta = [a[k] - b[k] for k in ids]
                indices = np.random.default_rng(42).integers(len(ids), size=(1000, len(ids)))
                boot = sorted(math.fsum(delta[i] for i in sample) / len(ids) for sample in indices)
                expected = [math.fsum(a.values()) / len(ids), math.fsum(b.values()) / len(ids),
                            math.fsum(delta) / len(ids), quantile(boot, .025), quantile(boot, .975)]
                actual = [value["first_source_balanced_mean"], value["second_source_balanced_mean"],
                          value["mean_first_minus_second"], *value["source_bootstrap_95_interval"]]
                for x, y in zip(expected, actual, strict=True):
                    errors.append(abs(x - y))
                    assert abs(x - y) < 1e-10, (panel, value["metric"], x, y)
    assert len(comparisons) == 54 and len(witnesses) == 18
    result = {"status": "completed-camera-only-primary-audit-full-photo-color-native-review-pending",
              "recorded_UTC": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan.json"), "operator": ref(__file__),
              "checkpoint_records": checkpoints, "coverage_and_arithmetic": audit,
              "source_balanced_CFA_PSNR": means, "comparisons": comparisons,
              "sources": sources, "witnesses": witnesses,
              "independent_scalar_check": {"scalars": len(errors), "bound": 1e-10,
                                             "maximum_difference": max(errors)},
              "CUDA_initialized": torch.cuda.is_initialized(),
              "scope": "Existing completed known/unseen outputs only: four/five scenes, two "
              "exposures and nine crops per scene/exposure. Independent direct18-crop scene "
              "fsum and scalar quantile replay of source bootstrap; no new inference. "
              "AHD is auxiliary/not exact RGB GT; registered CFA references have noise and "
              "registration limitations. Photo/color/real-native review remains pending. "
              "One training seed; no continuation, broad superiority or promotion claim."}
    output = ROOT / "camera-interim-statistics.json"
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"result": str(output), "means": means, "maximum_scalar_error": max(errors),
                      "maximum_witness_ULPs": max(w["maximum_float32_ULPs"] for w in witnesses)}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
